title: 12-hour power outage set in Ilocos Sur's 2nd District on Nov. 26

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The entire 2nd District of Ilocos Sur, except the municipalities of Sugpon, Cervantes, and Quirino, will experience a 12-hour scheduled power interruption on Thursday, Nov. 26, to allow for annual preventive maintenance and testing by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). In an advisory on Monday, the Ilocos Sur Electric Cooperative (ISECO)-Candon said the interruption will run from 6:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. The maintenance work will cover the 115-kilovolt (kV), 100-megavolt-ampere (MVA) Transformer No. 1 and its associated lines and equipment at the NGCP San Esteban Substation.
